package coverage_test

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	svc "example.com/coverage/gen/coverage"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type audit struct {
	phase string
	calls *int
}

func (a audit) Audit(ctx context.Context, info *svc.AuditInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	if a.calls != nil {
		(*a.calls)++
	}
	if a.phase == "payload" {
		p := info.Payload()
		p.SetValue(p.Value() + ":payload")
	}
	res, err := next(ctx, info.RawPayload())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if a.phase == "result" {
		r := info.Result(res)
		r.SetValue(r.Value() + ":result")
	}
	return res, nil
}

func TestClientAccessorCoverage(t *testing.T) {
	for _, phase := range []string{"payload", "result"} {
		for _, method := range []string{"overlap", "client-only"} {
			t.Run(phase+"/"+method, func(t *testing.T) {
				client := svc.NewClient(
					func(_ context.Context, p any) (any, error) {
						return &svc.AResult{Value: p.(*svc.APayload).Value}, nil
					},
					nil,
					func(_ context.Context, p any) (any, error) {
						return &svc.CResult{Value: p.(*svc.CPayload).Value}, nil
					}, audit{phase: phase})
				require.NotPanics(t, func() {
					var value string
					if method == "overlap" {
						res, err := client.A(context.Background(), &svc.APayload{Value: "a"})
						require.NoError(t, err)
						value = res.Value
						require.Equal(t, "a:"+phase, value)
					} else {
						res, err := client.C(context.Background(), &svc.CPayload{Value: "c"})
						require.NoError(t, err)
						value = res.Value
						require.Equal(t, "c:"+phase, value)
					}
				})
			})
		}
	}
}

func TestServerAccessorControl(t *testing.T) {
	for _, phase := range []string{"payload", "result"} {
		t.Run(phase, func(t *testing.T) {
			endpoint := svc.WrapAEndpoint(func(_ context.Context, p any) (any, error) {
				return &svc.AResult{Value: p.(*svc.APayload).Value}, nil
			}, audit{phase: phase})
			res, err := endpoint(context.Background(), &svc.APayload{Value: "server"})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, "server:"+phase, res.(*svc.AResult).Value)
		})
	}
}

type plainService struct{}

func (plainService) A(_ context.Context, p *svc.APayload) (*svc.AResult, error) {
	return &svc.AResult{Value: p.Value}, nil
}

func (plainService) B(_ context.Context, p *svc.BPayload) (*svc.BResult, error) {
	return &svc.BResult{Value: p.Value}, nil
}

func (plainService) C(_ context.Context, p *svc.CPayload) (*svc.CResult, error) {
	return &svc.CResult{Value: p.Value}, nil
}

func TestInvocationRemainsSideLocal(t *testing.T) {
	calls := 0
	interceptor := audit{phase: "payload", calls: &calls}
	server := svc.NewEndpoints(plainService{}, interceptor)
	res, err := server.C(context.Background(), &svc.CPayload{Value: "server-c"})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "server-c", res.(*svc.CResult).Value)
	require.Zero(t, calls, "client declaration must not install a server callback")
	client := svc.NewClient(nil, func(_ context.Context, p any) (any, error) {
		return &svc.BResult{Value: p.(*svc.BPayload).Value}, nil
	}, nil, interceptor)
	value, err := client.B(context.Background(), &svc.BPayload{Value: "plain"})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "plain", value.Value)
	require.Zero(t, calls, "server declaration must not install a client callback")
}
